name: At what stage of a room addition does drywall installation begin?

mainEntity.name: At what stage of a room addition does drywall installation begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall hanging begins only after rough framing, mechanical rough-ins, and insulation pass required local building inspections. If electrical wiring, plumbing lines, or HVAC ducts are closed in prematurely, inspectors will require drywall removal to verify code compliance. Once framing inspections are signed off, our crew hangs drywall panels, applies joint tape, and layers joint compound over screw heads and seams. Addressing any stud alignment issues or framing flaws before the boards go up ensures flat, even walls across the new addition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall installation starts only after rough framing, plumbing, electrical, and insulation pass inspections. Closing walls early can force costly tear-outs to expose uninspected work.
